thread: Week 1 HSK review quiz: 4 questions on tone changes and one tasty word. Can you score 4/4? 🧵 #learnchinese #HSK

2/ Q1: How do you say 不要 ("don't")?
A) bù yào  B) bú yào  C) bǔ yào

Q2: How do you say 一些 ("some")?
A) yī xiē  B) yí xiē  C) yì xiē

3/ Q3: How do you say 水果 ("fruit")? Both syllables are 3rd tones.
A) shuǐguǒ  B) shuíguǒ  C) shuìguǒ

Q4: What does 好吃 mean?
A) expensive  B) delicious  C) hungry

4/ Reply with your 4 answers (e.g. A-B-C-A) before checking the rules: 不 + 4th tone → bú, 一 + 4th → yí, 一 + tones 1/2/3 → yì, 3rd + 3rd → 2nd + 3rd.
